_: Battle orders (Mac 2026-11-16: 'it would be awesome if game of crowns adhered to those formations'; docs/art/battle_formations, the approved pictures): how a side stands for a battle, one row each. rows: front to back, each takes up to `abreast` regiments of `role` (melee, ranged; melee falls back to whatever foot is left), `gap` before it (world units; army.json line.rowGap when absent), `line` its number (1 the front line, 2 a second line that relieves it). horse: wings (beside the front row, left and right in turn), reserve (behind the last row, in the middle), flank (beside the front row on one side). Regiments a row didn't take stand in rows of two behind. army_formation.gd line_places reads it; army_field.gd picks the order (pick).

pick._: battle_orders.gd pick: a commander's choice (utility scoring, as Total War's and Age of Empires' battle AIs weigh their options; Mac 2026-11-16: 'different strategies for different battles given the size of the other army, terrain etc', 'well thought of and not repetitive'). Each order scores base, plus outnumbered times how far it is outnumbered (1 - its men over the foe's, 0 when it is not), plus outnumbers times how far it outnumbers the foe, plus rise times how much higher its ground stands than the foe's (world units), plus foe_horse times the foe's share of horse, plus foot times its foot regiments past foot_from, plus horse times its own share of horse; less repeat when its house stood so last time; plus up to jitter at random. The highest wins.

relief._: army_field.gd _orders_tick, a second line's relief (the Strategikon's and the Roman triplex acies' line relief): a front regiment at blows with no more than at of its figures standing is relieved by the nearest second-line regiment still standing; once its relief is within near (plus its depth) of it, the worn regiment falls back to where its relief stood, at back times field.advance, and stands. A horse reserve rides out once any regiment of its side is at blows.

command._: army_field.gd reorder, the King's orders in a battle (Total War's and Bannerlord's formation orders): the crown's side forms anew about its front's middle, each regiment marching to its new place at pace times field.advance (a regiment at blows breaks off), then acts by the order: advance (its first line goes in; a second line and a horse reserve wait), hold (all stand where they formed, the foe must come to them; ranged loose from there). regroup_back: how far behind its front a regroup (an order with hold) forms. buttons: the orders on battle_orders_bar.gd, left to right; chosen: the word on the order the side stands in.
command.title: Orders

hints.line: Two blocks abreast, archers behind, horse on the wings. All go in.
hints.two_lines: A second line waits to relieve the first. Horse held back.
hints.shield_wall: Close ranks and hold. The foe must come to you.
hints.regroup: Break off, fall back, and form again.

_defence: orders.<key>.defence: army_combat.gd, how much better a regiment in that order stands against foot, a charge (horse) and arrows on its front (1 as it is): the shield wall's locked shields; the regroup's closed ranks. attack: how hard its men press their foe (a wall stands, it doesn't press).
